items.example: There was a glitch and my game froze.
items.exampleTr: Bir aksaklık oldu ve oyunum dondu.
items.simple: A small problem that stops a machine from working for a bit.

items.example: I lost everything because I had no backup.
items.exampleTr: Yedeğim olmadığı için her şeyi kaybettim.
items.simple: A second copy you keep in case the first one is lost.

items.example: My laptop crashed in the middle of the essay.
items.simple: The computer stops working all of a sudden.

items.example: This app keeps freezing on my phone.
items.simple: The screen stops moving again and again.

items.en: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
items.example: Have you tried turning it off and on again?
items.simple: The first thing to do when a machine does not work.

items.example: The Wi-Fi went down, so we went offline.
items.exampleTr: Wi-Fi gitti, biz de çevrim dışı kaldık.
items.simple: You are not connected to the internet any more.

items.example: My gran isn't very tech-savvy.
items.simple: You know how to use phones and computers well.

items.example: Sorry, I'm not tech-savvy. Can you help me?
items.exampleTr: Kusura bakma, teknolojiden anlamam. Yardım eder misin?
items.simple: You are not good with computers and phones.

items.example: Call me quickly. My battery's about to die.
items.exampleTr: Çabuk ara beni. Şarjım bitmek üzere.
items.simple: Your phone has almost no power left.

items.example: My phone ran out of battery on the bus.
items.simple: The power in your phone is all gone.

items.example: Take a screenshot of the text and send it.
items.simple: You save a picture of what is on your screen.

items.example: Someone hacked into my email account.
items.simple: A person gets into your account without asking you.

items.example: The video call is really laggy today.
items.simple: It is slow, so what you see comes a bit late.

items.example: It won't let me upload the photo.
items.simple: The machine says no when you try to do something.

items.example: Is the Wi-Fi down or is it just me?
items.exampleTr: Wi-Fi gitti mi, yoksa sadece bende mi?
items.simple: You ask if the internet at home is not working.

items.example: There's a bug in the app. It keeps closing.
items.exampleTr: Uygulamada bir hata var. Sürekli kapanıyor.
items.simple: A mistake in a program that makes it work badly.

items.example: Try restarting the router.
items.simple: A box at home that gives you Wi-Fi.

items.example: I've run out of storage on my phone.
items.simple: The space where your phone keeps photos and apps.

items.example: The video keeps buffering. The signal's awful.
items.simple: The video stops and waits to load again.

items.example: My inbox is full of spam.
items.simple: Many messages you did not ask for.

items.example: My phone is outdated. It's so slow.
items.simple: Old and not the newest any more.

items.example: This app is really user-friendly.
items.simple: Easy for anyone to use.

items.example: Scroll down to see more photos.
items.exampleTr: Daha fazla fotoğraf görmek için aşağı kaydır.
items.simple: You move the page with your finger to see lower parts.
